what: Design says CB descriptors stay uniform, sized with core_w_tiles_max, while ragged cores push rows*Wc (Wc < Wc_max) per block. A CB capacity that is not a multiple of the push quantum wraps mid-block (write pointer runs past fifo_limit); the reference never states this rule.
